title: Task Architecture and Learning from Coarse Performance
abstract: arXiv:2610.00322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizations often learn about competence only from project-level success or failure, even when a project contains several complementary tasks. We compare task architectures by the Blackwell order. An expert of unknown fixed competence can perform all tasks in one bundled project, one task in a project completed by an outside technology, or the same number of tasks across separate projects. Bundling dominates a single narrow assignment below an outside-reliability threshold and is otherwise incomparable with it. Holding the expert's workload fixed strictly lowers this threshold but does not overturn the result: bundling still dominates when the outside technology is sufficiently unreliable, separate projects dominate only when that technology is perfect, and the experiments are otherwise incomparable. We derive the thresholds for any number of tasks and show that the fixed-workload threshold decreases to zero as task scope grows. Explic

translated_title: 任务架构与从粗略绩效中学习
translated_abstract: 组织通常只能从项目层面的成功或失败中了解一个人的能力，即使该项目包含多个互补任务。我们采用Blackwell序来比较不同的任务架构。假设一位能力未知且固定的专家，可以选择完成一个捆绑项目中的全部任务，也可以只完成某一任务（其余任务由外部技术完成），或者在多个独立项目中完成相同数量的任务。研究表明：当外部技术的可靠性低于某一阈值时，捆绑任务优于单一的窄范围任务分配；高于该阈值时两者不可比较。若保持专家的工作量固定，会严格降低这一阈值，但不会推翻上述结论：当外部技术足够不可靠时，捆绑仍占优；只有当外部技术完美可靠时，独立项目才占优；其余情况下两种实验方式不可比较。我们推导了任意任务数量下的阈值，并证明在固定工作量的条件下，该阈值随任务范围的扩大而递减至零。
tldr: 本文用Blackwell序比较组织评估专家能力的不同任务架构，证明当外部技术可靠性低于某阈值时捆绑多任务的学习效果最优，且固定专家工作量会严格降低该阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper compares task architectures for learning about competence via the Blackwell order, showing that bundling tasks dominates below an outside-reliability threshold, and fixing the expert's workload strictly lowers this threshold.
